label: Business Planning
description: Develop business strategy, operating model, market approach, or strategic initiative plan.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for business strategy, GTM shape, or strategic planning.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for technical implementation steps only.

label: Market Analysis
description: Analyze market dynamics, segments, competitors, trends, and opportunities.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about market opportunity or strategic positioning.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for verified breaking news only.

label: Competitive Review
description: Compare competitors, alternatives, differentiation, and strategic risks.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how something compares competitively.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for simple price comparison only.

label: Scenario Planning
description: Explore scenarios, assumptions, risks, mitigations, and decision triggers.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what could happen under different strategic assumptions.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for exact forecast certainty.

label: SWOT Analysis
description: Analyze strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for SWOT or strategic situation analysis.

label: OKR Definition
description: Define objectives, key results, initiatives, and measures.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for OKRs or strategic goals.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for sprint task details only.

label: Board Brief
description: Prepare board or executive strategy briefs.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for executive or board-level summary.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for casual social post.

label: Operating Model
description: Design organizational operating models, responsibilities, and cadence.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how an organization should operate.

label: Pricing Strategy
description: Develop pricing strategy, packaging, and market fit.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for exact invoice review.

label: Partnership Evaluation
description: Evaluate partnerships, channels, alliances, or ecosystem opportunities.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a partnership makes sense.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for vendor procurement scorecard only.
